**World rules in the export: no more /gamerule after each export**

The export dialog has a Rules tab: the game mode, the difficulty, and the world's game rules, written into the world so that it opens as set. Pick a preset, Creative / Frozen (nothing spawns, spreads, grows or decays, no weather nor day going by, noon for good: to walk round a map as it was built), Survival safe (fire does not spread, mobs break no blocks) or Vanilla, or set each rule: mobs, pillager patrols, the wandering trader, phantoms, mobs changing blocks, fire spreading, random ticks, keeping one's inventory, the day and the weather going by, the time of day and the weather. Save a set of rules under your own name with Save as preset… (Settings ▸ Export lists them), and each map keeps the rules of its last export. They are written as each version of Minecraft names them, the new names of 1.21.11 and the file of their own of 26.1 included.
